items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: And she and King Jones, it was King Jones, did you ever hear of King Jones?

ctx.x: She had a -- she was real thin, but had a very pretty figure and fast as a racehorse, she'd get on the floor and she could twist and turn and she tore up everything, she was very famous then in Chicago at that time. And she and King Jones, it was King Jones, did you ever hear of King Jones?
